title: Candidate Config
description: A single evaluatable configuration under consideration for promotion, e.g. a runtime, routing, prompt, policy, or scheduler variant. The configuration payload itself is intentionally opaque -- this package must never assume its internal shape.

target.description: An open, illustrative classification of what this candidate configures, e.g. 'runtime', 'routing', 'policy', 'scheduler' -- not a fixed enum.
